career_ladder.note: Assistant Statistical Officer (Sahayak Sankhyiki Adhikari) and Assistant Research Officer - Statistics (Sahayak Shodh Adhikari) conduct macroeconomic data collection, agricultural census surveys, state income estimations, and socio-economic evaluations across the Economics and Statistics Division (State Planning Institute), Department of Agriculture, and Family Welfare Directorate, Government of Uttar Pradesh.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is made through a competitive objective written examination of 120 marks testing General Hindi, General Knowledge, and specialized postgraduate subject knowledge (Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Mathematical Statistics), followed by document verification of postgraduate degrees and NIELIT 'O' Level computer certifications. Negative marking is 0.25 (1/4th) per wrong answer.

financial_package.note: Assistant Statistical Officer and Assistant Research Officer are remunerated at Pay Level 6 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Economics & Statistics Division & UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 6
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹3,200 to ₹6,500 depending on district or state planning institute headquarters posting in Lucknow), field statistical survey allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,593), professional tax, and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting city tier (Class X, Y, Z)
Statistical survey conveyance and touring reimbursement for census operations
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Leave travel concession (LTC) and annual earned leave encashment benefits
